data.name: 驾考家园
data.detailed_description:
Driving Test Home is a game that simulates a 3D driving test. Like many students, the developers of Driving Test Home have gone through a painful, helpless, and long process of learning to drive, especially during the period of subject two. They have put in a lot of effort, time, and money, and finally passed subject two through a makeup exam. I believe that many students are still worried about subject two, such as reversing and parking. This experience has inspired us to have the idea of independently innovating and developing 3D car training and counting on mobile phones, tablets, Windows, and MacOS. Therefore, Driving Test Home was born in 2016.

The driving test home is specially designed for car learners, which can truly help everyone. Through game simulations, we can help everyone quickly master the operation steps, remember to look at the position, proficiently turn the direction, reduce unnecessary operation errors during car practice, shorten the time of car practice, and greatly improve efficiency (absolutely greatly reducing the number of times to scold the coach:)

A great helper for coaches

The driving test home has multiple gameplay modes, including exam mode, learning mode, and free mode. Multiple perspectives allow you to easily grasp the positioning, and supports external devices such as steering wheel connection devices, controllers, etc; The types of driver's licenses covered include: C1, C2, B1, B2, A1, A2, with various test vehicle models for game players to choose from, and a 1:1 simulation of real test rooms.

Trainees can improve their efficiency in boarding practice by simulating driving at home, which allows coaches to save teaching time. By arranging more trainees to board and practice in the same amount of time, it greatly saves time and costs such as gasoline.

The powerful 3D car training function of K2 K3

1. The driving test home subject 2 3D car training has the following projects:

There are over 700 3D real examination centers in various provinces across the country, allowing you to directly practice driving in these centers anytime, anywhere.

There are also right angle turns, curved driving, reverse parking, side parking, slope starting, parking and card picking, rainy and foggy slippery roads, emergency situations, narrow road U-turns, tunnel simulation, five consecutive exams, and nine consecutive exams; There are more unique experience driving projects available: underground garage, challenge parking, and intensive training. It also provides a super powerful function of customizing the exam room, which is completely designed by you. You can also add special reference points on your exam room.

2. The driving test home subject three 3D car training has the following projects:

The fully realistic lighting simulation learning system not only allows continuous lighting, but also allows you to customize lighting questions, enabling students from every region of the country to match lighting exam questions 100%.

In addition to the 16 individual and consecutive exam projects in Subject 3, 3D driving training also provides unique road experience projects for you to challenge on the road: Hong Kong Zhuhai Macao Bridge project, Guizhou Qinglong 24 Road turning project, Guoliang Village wall hanging road project, Zhuhai International Circuit project, and San Francisco Nine Bend Flower Street project in the United States.

Subject 3 also provides a powerful feature for customizing 3D exam rooms. Come and design your own exam route for Subject 3 now.

3. Provide a massive collection of 3D training car models:

We provide over 40 exam models from various regions across the country for you to choose from, and you will definitely find your exam model

data.short_description: 驾考家园是一款模拟3D驾考的游戏，拥有多种玩法模式，包含考试模式、学习模式、自由模式；多种视角让您轻松掌握点位技巧；同时支持多种外接设备供玩家选择，如方向盘连接设备、手柄等；驾考家园目前包含科目二、科目三3D模拟，涵盖驾照类型包括：C1、C2、B1、B2、A1、A2，拥有各款考试车型供游戏玩家选择，真实考场模拟1:1还原，提供考场看场功能，让您考前做好充足的准备；多种挑战项目供玩家选择，让您在紧张的学车过程中增添一些额外的挑战和乐趣。
